instructor: He is always so happy and hyped. It made me excited and happy as well.
course: It is a little confusing but once you learn logic is actually fun. This was probably the only course that taught me something in all of my university time.

instructor: The instructor's strongest point was that he was able to create a pedagogical context in the classroom that allowed us to understand the topics comfortably. However, he was frequently unpunctual in terms of sharing information about the assignments. We had occasions in which he said he would upload the answers to exercises before quizzes and do not share the answers on time for us to study for quizzes. Despite his frequent problems with punctuality, he was not understanding our problems concerning punctuality. For example, a couple of people were unable to attend quizzes because of technical problems like internet connections. Once, he uploaded a file that was incompatible with some computers (which he should have considered as he expects us to do for many tasks),  and those students had to miss the quiz because of the instructor's fault.

He was always so cool, adorable and fun. But he almost did not grade any quiz on time, we just know about one of our quiz grades! I do not even know if I did a good, or a terrible work in this class. But I kind of liked logic and he kept me interested during the semester.

We took 10 quizzes during the semester. At the end of the semester, only one quiz grade was announced. It's not a good thing. Furthermore, the professor did not obey the deadlines. He need to change  this style.

Konuya olan heyecanı gerçekten dinlerken hissediyoruz. Anlattığı şeyi çok sevdiğinden ve işini severek yaptığından eminim. Ancak, 26 araliktayiz ve şuana kadar sanırım 8 quizz olduk ve iki gün sonra final essayimizin teslim tarihi olmasına rağmen, hiçbir notumuzu bilmiyoruz henüz. Ilk essayimizin drafti için de feedback vermedi henüz. Iyi aldığımı bildiğim için bunun benim üzerimdeolumsuz bir etkisi olmuyor. Ancak, adil olduğunu düşünmüyorum. Özellikle bizden her şeyi zamanında yapmamızı bekleyen bir okuldan ve hocadan.

Murali is a very helpful instructor and he motivated a lot during the times that I felt course is hard. He encourages active participation and tries to help students as much as he can. Also, he explains the materials very clearly. I am happy to take this lecture from him
He did not give feedback on time both for quizzes and the draft. Thus, I had no idea of whether I was failing or not until the end of the semester.
He is really slow at grading quizzes and essays.

Strongest:- He knows his stuff. His English is very clear to understand. The examples he provided in the class are fun. He always provides hand notes before the class. So it is easy to follow him during the class. He is very lenient in grading. He graded us in letter grades (A,A-,B,... etc), not in points out of 10 or 100. So, even if we made minor mistakes, we got full points.

Weakest:- First of all, he assumes that the student knows all the classroom behavior. So he often becomes angry(or disappointed might be a better term) when the students fail to do so. Second, He didn't state the course plan rigidly at the beginning of the semester but I guess that's because it was his first time teaching this course. Third, he is quite amateur in terms of using technology. So the students faced problems during quizzes, moodle upload, formatting etc. The more the semester advances, it becomes better. Overall, it was a nice semester excluding those two-three little incidents.

Mr. Ramachandran is very eager on teaching logic. Yet, I think sometimes he forgets that students are left behind and goes on his own pace. He's student friendly and he always repeats himself if someone doesn't understand something.
course: It was so hard to complete the quizzes in a very short time. My computer and keyboard are also so problematic,so considering this course is mainly based on quiz grades, I am sadly expecting a low total grade.

Herkesin bir kere düşünmüş olabileceği ve sürekli karşılaştığımız paradokslari incelememiz heyecan verici. Güzel şeyler de çıkıyor sonuç olarak, insanın düşünme biçimine direkt etki edebilecek bir ders. Akademik düzeyde felsefe metinleri okumamda çok yardımı oldu, mantık sembollerinin. Felsefecilerin kullanmayı çok sevdiği işaretler ve bu ders sayesinde öğrenebildim bunları.

I think the course was very well structured and I learned a lot in this course. Especially doing exercises in the breakout rooms were very beneficial. The course content helped me a lot learn in this course. However, the instructor was not very efficient in helping with our questions. So, I learned many things by myself through the course material rather than learning during lectures.

Strongest:- It is logic. You have to learn it. It teaches you the basics of sentential logic(SL) and predicate logic(PL). It also goes deep in sentential logic. After taking the course, you will feel the whole world a little bit stupider than you used to feel before. 

Weakest:- This course only covers SL and touches the translation part of PL. It doesn't cover modal logic, deontic logic, deviant logic and so on. This is an introductory course but the PHIL department doesn't offer us a course on intermediate logic. So we cannot learn these systems of logic. Also, this course includes some paradoxes which is unfortunate. This takes a lot of our time but we already have a course dedicated to paradox and infinity. So it doesn't make sense to study paradoxes in this course too. I'd like to get more logic lessons in this course.
This is a very important course, I think every department should have this course as mandatory. It helps students to gain critical thinking and argument creating. No bad aspect of the course.

instructor: I don't see any weak points; I am happy to have the chance to take this course from Professor Ramachandran. He explained the course content really well, and thanks to him, I've learned a lot about logic.
Murali Ramachandran is really knowledgeable. He will help students understand and properly indicate what he expects from everyone. He is a student-friendly professor.
He was exceptionally opinionated,  not in a good sense. Even if something is technically/logically/experimentally correct, he would always mark you wrong if you do not do it in a way that he wishes.
course: Course is a nice entry level course. Workload is not torturous and easily doable. You have plenty of time to do the assignments.

The quiz system of the course is great. Since there is a lot to learn, it would be very difficult to handle them right before a midterm or a final. In this way, I studied regularly, learned better, and probably got better marks.

instructor: He is a nice guy. And he loves movies.

An amazing instructor, his complete and absolute grasp of the class and the learning process only ever becomes clearer as the semester progresses. He knows what we will struggle with, both regarding course material and otherwise. Due to his foresight, he makes adjustments and interventions that we don't see the reasoning behind when it happens. His exceptional experience obscures any shortcomings he might've had.

Murali Hoca bu sene benim en zorlandığım dersi işledi. En büyük olumsuz yanı quizlere 15 dk vermesi. Nereye kime acelemiz var? Ben yavaş yazan bir insanım ve sınavı düşünerek çözmek istiyorum. Koskoca iki ders saatimiz vardı. Fakat biz 15dkda quizi yetiştirmeye çalışıyorduk, bana çok saçma gelen bir uygulamaydı bu. Hoca bayağı esprili ve samimi bir insandı kendisiyle bir problemim olmadı. Sadece ne dediğini anlamak bazen çok zor çünkü ÇOK HIZLI KONUŞUYOR. Sorunuz varsa lütfen sorun hızlı gidiyorsam da uyarın diyor ama böyle bir şey imkansız çünkü sorumuzu sorunca daha konuşmamıza izin vermeden hızlıca cevap vermeye çalışıyor. Argümanları sadece okudu ve nasıl anlamamız gerektiğini anlattı sınıfta oturup düzgün bir discussion yapmadık bence bu bir felsefe dersi için büyük bir eksik. İnsan zaten konuşmaya çekiniyor çünkü ya sen hocayı anlayamıyorsun ya da dediğin şeyi hoca dinlemeyip kendi kafasındaki şeyi açıklıyor. Dersi alacak kişilere sabır diliyorum.
He is so funny. I Love him.
course: Guys, logic is brain damaging.
Incredibly useful, we acquired a fundemental tool of thought that no one should live with its absence.

Positive side: Murali Ramachandran
Negative: So many quizzes

instructor: Murali Hoca was a very good instructor. He always wanted us to push our limits and find arguments that we "critically engage" with some of the ancient philosophers. In order to get a high grade, you will have to criticize everything on a plausible basis.  I really understood his lessons but I think he relies too much on breakout rooms. I, personally, did not find those breakout rooms efficient because those discussions were held with 2 to 3 students who were definitely not interested in the topic and had no clue what we were discussing on.  Other than that, it was a great semester, he is very sweet and his slides were definitely clear. I learned a lot from him.

Muralı Hoca'nın bu okuldaki ilk yılıydı. Başta size aşırı pozitif bir insan olduğunu düşündürüyor ama öyle değil bence. Beklemediğiniz anlarda beklemediğiniz tepkilerle karşılaşabiliyorsunuz ve bu tepkileri sizin derse katılma hevesinizi kırıyor kesinlikle. Ayrıca dönem sonu gelmiş olmasına rağmen tek bir notumuz bile açıklanmadı. Anlıyorum, çok yoğun ve zor bir dönem ama bu hepimiz için geçerli. Bizden anlayış bekliyorsa kendisi de aynı anlayışı göstermeli bence.

Murali hoca neşeli ve konuşkan bir hoca fakat bazen çok hızlı konuşuyor ve bu onu anlamamızı güçleştiren bir durum. Bunun yanı sıra öğrencilerden çok fazla şey bekliyor, fazla sorumluluk veriyor ve bu insanı yoruyor. Detaylara takılan ve felsefi olarak çok iyi yazmamızı bekleyen bir hoca olduğu için notlandırmasının pek iyi olduğunu söyleyemem. Attendance'a çok önem veren dakik olan bir hoca.

He is a great teacher who understands the concept of quality education over the quantity of education unlike many professors in Bilkent. 
He made the course interesting. Loved his teaching style but we used breakout rooms too often (I guess that's a negative aspect of the online course)
Ders yükü zaten yeterince ağır olan bir derste öğrencilerin daha fazlasını yapmaları için beklenti içinde olması, dersi daha da yorucu hâle getiriyor. Ancak anlayışlı ve güleryüzlü bir hoca.

Professor Ramachandran, overall, was really good. He really helps students understand the concepts they are learning. He is kind, warm and happy. He always explicitly and clearly states what the student should do, from deadlines to methods. On top of that he forms a bond with the student aside the class as well. The only slightly negative thing was that he took a long time grading essays. But considering COVID-19 that is highly understandable.
always puts us into breakout rooms even when there is nothing to talk about
Very cheerful, understanding and helpful towards his students.
course: Zorunlu bir ders olmamalı. İlginizi çekmiyorsa işkence gibi. Çekiyorsa keyifli ama.

Strongest: Reading and discussing texts and ideas can be really fun if you are willing and able. Course may seem a lot together with its English Component but the workload for the 2 parts are nor divided. If readings are done you can be successful in both parts.
Weakest: Course readings are too West-Centric. They are like the copy-pastes of US or UK syllabi. We should be able to see the syllabus content so that we can see which texts and reading are read on the course and/or if there are any philosophers from around the world other than Europe. As far as I know there are not such sections. A wider variety of philosophers should at least me mentioned if not studied.

Ders öğrenciyi diğer derslerinden alı koyacak cinsten yoğunlukta olan bir ders.  Humanity gibi benzer ders yükü olan bir ders ile eş zamanda almanızı kesinlikle önermem. Her hafta yeni okumalar yapılan, felsefi essay'ler yazmamız beklenilen, notlandırmasında detaylara çok dikkat edilen oldukça yorucu bir ders. Ayrıca derste işlenen metinlerin dili ağır olduğu için okuma süresi uzuyor. Zaman ayırılması gereken fakat felsefe bilgisi anlamında insanı geliştiren bir ders. Felsefeye pek ilgi duymayan bir insanın zorlanacağı ve bunalacağı bir ders.

instructor: Murali is a really good and kind person. In every lesson, I felt that he worked really hard for us to be successful. Although philosophy is a very difficult subject, he really worked hard. He prepared presentations and additional studies for our benefits. He gave feedbacks for our essays both in writing and via zoom. I hope he will be very happy in his next life. As a law student, I thank him very much for his contributions and for making me love philosophy.

It is quite hard to say that the instructor is successful in his profession. Additionally, he is rude and disrespectful toward students. He couldn't explain his expectations about the tasks and the whole course. He is anywhere near from being an instructor at Bilkent University. IF YOU WILL TAKE THIS COURSE, DO NOT PREFER MURALI RAMACHANDRAN

He is so nice and kind that he nevers hurts you. I'm really happy to take a lecture from him. He has a deep notion about philosophy and tries his best to share his understanding.  If he could stay here, I would take one more lecture from him, exactly. I have more interest in philosophy thanks to him.
He was good at teaching philosophy to the class but when he gives feedbacks his expectations for essays was not that clear.

Hocanın notu inanılmaz kıttı Bir şey beğendirebilmek neredeyse imkansızdı. Bütün sene boyunca yaptığımız hiçbir ödevin yazdığımız hiçbir yazının notunu girmedi, arkadaşların da soyledigine göre dönemin son günü kimse itiraz etmesin diye sistem kapanmadan önce bütün notları olabilecek en düşük şekilde giriyor muş. Anlaşılan o ki bu sene de aynısını yapacak. Notunun düşük olmasının dışında olumsuz yönü olduğunu söyleyemem. Bizimle iletişimi, ders anlatışı, verdiği projeler konusunda iyi ve öğreticiydi.
course: Dersin iş yükü inanılmaz fazla olduğu için kendi bölüm derslerime bile bu ders yüzünden çalışamadım.
It is really hard content. Also, there are lots of readings; so, we cannot really concentrate on them. I don't think that such a high number of readings are beneficial for us.

instructor: He is a quite kind person. However, his essay questions were not so clear and hard to understand. The questions give us a hard time understanding and write. Also, my suggestion to him is to include discussion sessions every week to increase participation.

I did not even understand what he expects from students in essays or other assignments. He read our essays after the 2nd essay which is very late and almost at the end of the semester, so I cannot see my mistakes and have no chance to correct them. Also, he always put us in breakout rooms and it was very inefficient for me. He gave a reaction when someone says that s/he did not know the answer to what he is asked, and it gives me lots of pressure. However, he is kind personally.

Murali çok iyi bir insan fakat ders konusunda bize bazı zorluklar çıkardığını söyleyebilirim. Yazdığımız essaylerin puanı hala açıklanmadığı için diğer essayleri yazarken neye dikkat etmemiz gerektiğini neleri değiştirmemiz gerektiğini tam olarak anlamak zordu. Feedback verdi fakat bu feedbackler pek de yararlı değildi. Dersi zevkli işliyordu ama bu durumlar benim derse olan hevesimi kırdı. Ayrıca, bu dersi alan kişilere felsefe öğrencisiymiş gibi bakıp böyle bir beklentisi olduğunu gördüm.

kendini ogrencinin yerine koyamiyor, bizden felsefe bolumu ogrencisiymisiz gibi essayler bekliyor ve  geneli dusuk. Ben belki yuksek aldim ama cidden canimi cikardi. breakout roomlara ayirip duruyor fakat dersi inanilmaz kotu islemesinden kaynakli verim elde edemiyor. Gordugum en basarisiz hocalardan

Olumlu bir yönü bulunmamakta. Not değerlendirmesi ve essay feedbackleri alanında yetersizdi. Tam olarak dersle alakalı ne yaptığımızı bilmiyor ya da kesin bilgilere geç ulaşıyorduk.  Ödev zamanlamaları ve ödev teslim zamanları öğrencinin faydasına değil zararınaydı. Kesinlikle sistemi tam oturtamamış ve oluşan covid-19 online okul sürecinde öğrencilere destek olması gerekirken bunun tam tersini uygulamıştır.

Genel olarak asla ne istediğini ne beklediğini anlamak mümkün olmuyor. Feedback verme tarzı öğrenciye katkı sağlamıyor çünkü her şeyi çok geç okuyor. Zaten anlayamıyorsun da neden feedback verdiğini, vermese de olur yani. 6 kredilik bir ders için oldukça zor şartlar sağladı herkes için ve çoğu zaman derslere girmekten nefret ettim. Kendisinin öğrencilere yardımcı olmak istediğine inanmıyorum çünkü bize ayırmak ZORUNDA OLDUĞU  zamanı bir lütufmuş gibi lanse etti. İyi bir felsefeci olabilir?? ancak iyi bir öğretim elemanı olduğunu düşünmüyorum.
course: Derin iş yükü çok fazla. Haftada en çok çalışmamız gereken ders felsefe. Çok yourucu bir ders. Ders yükünün düşürülmesi gerektiğini düşünüyorum.
Too much to learn in one semester. Those philosophers are important to study, however, we have less time to cover and comprehend.
ders 243 e gore daha zorlayiciydi isledigimiz felsefeciler agirdi
Olumlu bir yanı yoktu

Herhangi bir olumlu tarafı bulunmamakta. Eğer düşünülmesi gerekilen şey akademik düşünce ve bu mekanizmanın gelişmesi ise, bu mekanizmayi daha farklı derslerle geliştirebilirdim. Geçirdiğimiz bir dönemde bana yaşattığı tek şey iş yükü, fazla ve oransız sorumluluk ve kısmi olarak eziyettir.

instructor: The assignments given by him are the most problematic and time consuming assignments in this semester. He delayed nearly all of the assignments but never extended deadlines for them. Feedbacks given by him were generally ineffective, inadequate and rarely improved our essay writing skills.
Murali has such a positive energy. He really wants students to contribute and express their ideas and he works for that. I think he is one of the best philosophy intructors.

In the feedback sessions, the teacher does his best to not understand what is written. He usually exceeds the time to upload assignments and never help us . he cannot follow the syllabus. In short, he wants a lot from the students, but fails to do his part.

I lost my interest in the lesson because of the teaching structure and Murali’s attitude.First of all, I think that the lesson is not very planned.The resources he uploaded to Moodle are not organized and since he updated the files at the beginning of every course day, I couldn't get the sources beforehand to print.This dropped my productivity a lot.  Secondly, he uses the breakout room feature in Zoom a lot. Since English is our second language and the resources are written in a very heavy language, it takes time to read the sources.But I guess Murali could not understand this.The time in the breakouts was very limited and therefore, I was very nervous in the lessons. Especially in one lesson, he gave us time in a breakout room to read and discuss the sources. Literally after 2-3 minutes, he said "I was bored" and suddenly took us to the main room.That did not make me feel valued as a student,and frankly,I can say that I lost my trust and focus after this issue. In general, I don't think he cares much about his students because he always promised that he will announce our first essay notes and feedback on Friday EVERY WEEK, and he kept us waiting for almost 2 months. He tried to explain the reason for this with that the essays are not interconnected, but I think this is not a valid excuse.I am not satisfied with the grade I received with the education I received. Although my performance in the English part of the lesson was good,I don't see the reason why I got so bad in the philosophy part. I questioned myself a lot that I could not understand this lesson, but when he refused to answer any of my questions in the asking session, I recently realized that it was really not my fault.How could I get such different grades when the philosophy part of the course processed the same as in English part?I think I am a realist student in terms of self-evaluation, but I really do not blame myself this time. The trust between the student and the instructor was very shaken,sorry.

He is not stating what he wants from us. I took 243 and wrote with the same structure, I am talking about introduction, body1 etc. He says it is wrong but doesn't explain what is wrong. It was hard to follow his lecture. I know he knows something, but he can't explain. Grading is also low. We are already learning something that even native speakers learn in their Ph.D. program, he doesn't show any sympathy to students, can't understand our statements. And always late with grading and sending essay questions. There is no proper feedback. Even in consulting sessions, he doesn't answer the basic questions like "Did I understand wrong?" I don't know what to expect from this course and I think he doesn't know either. In the beginning, he tried to make the lectures easier, and I think he is really a good person with respect, but his teaching skills must improve. Philosophy is not our main department, I think he is forgetting this and expect us to write just like a philosopher. Even great thinkers are in a dilemma, how can we write something they don't know? Also, in the essay when I express my thoughts he says that it is your opinion where is your argument? Is not the course intention to express our thoughts according to philosopher's thoughts and examine them? With being sorry, I didn't understand anything from his expectations.

Murali is a kind instructor but I am upset to take this course from him. He is not clear about what he wants in essays, he always says that we do not exactly understand the philosopher but we are not philosophers, even not philosophy students. Also, the instructor wants us to participate in the class continuously, but when we express our opinion on any subject, I think he does not welcome it very well and thinks it is wrong if it is beyond his own opinion. By sending us our first essay notes almost at the end of the semester, he prevented us from improving our mistakes. Shortly, I do not recommend that you make a difficult course more difficult by taking it from Murali.
course: Thinkers like Hume and Kant are hard.

It was very complicated. The sources were written in such a heavy language and the workload is really tiring. The things we do in the English part and the philosophy part of the lesson are the same, so it is a very inefficient course. Please change the structure or the design of the course. I read the offerings, the students were asking for it but the things are the same. Please consider our forms.

The lesson is absolutely irrelevant to the most curriculum. Total torture if you don't have a good teacher and there are very few.  nobody is happy with this lesson. This lesson is definitely a pedagogical mistake. The time we spent on this lesson is simply a waste I hope they will realize these facts....

I find it strange that a course which is not related to our department has such a credit weight and workload. I think this high expectation is not normal. We are not able to show the importance we should show to our other lessons and we spend too much time fulfilling the responsibilities of this course throughout the semester. As if this was not enough, I find it quite meaningless to give the course in two terms, 243 and 244. A lesson that is not liked by students and seen as an unnecessary burden, I hope its burden will decrease for students in the future.

Texts that we have read during the course was really hard to understand. Ideas of the philosophers are actually not that complicated but the problem is the old language. I had a difficulty to unnderstand and connect the ideas because of this. Besides, it is also challenging to express yourself and explain what you think since you cannot understand the language easily.

instructor: Prof. Ramachandran is extremely knowledgeable and very passionate about the topic. He explains complex ideas in a very clear way. His feedbacks are amazing and I think he is one of the best -and probably the best- instructor I had in Bilkent.
course: The course was highly interactive and we immediately receive feedback from both our instructor and our peers, which was highly useful. This is an advanced course, so it might be a difficult one for those not familiar enough with philosophy. The only concern someone might have about this course is its not being a standard History of Analytic Philosophy course. This is more like a "special topics in analytic philosophy" course, rather than a standard history of analytic philosophy course. Which was totally fine by me!

instructor:
He is very knowledgeable in his area and he is personally interested in the topics he teaches. He provides detailed feedback on assignments.
He could pay more attention to listening to his students. Sometimes he interrupts them before they complete their sentences.
